zh.title: 一个可靠的 Agent，从清晰的循环开始
zh.summary: 把模型输入、工具执行与历史记录分开，让每一步都有可以检查的结果。
zh.author: Loop

en.title: Reliable agents start with a clear loop
en.summary: Separate model input, tool execution and history so that every step leaves an inspectable result.
en.author: Loop

zh.title: 上下文变长之后，如何保留有用的信息
zh.summary: 压缩对话之前，先分清目标、证据与尚未完成的工作。
zh.author: Loop

en.title: Keeping useful context as conversations grow
en.summary: Before compressing a conversation, separate the goal, the evidence and the unfinished work.
en.author: Loop

zh.title: 让长任务的控制权始终清晰
zh.summary: 从补充输入、停止与继续出发，设计可理解的自动化体验。
zh.author: Loop

en.title: Staying in control of longer tasks
en.summary: Design understandable automation around additional input, stopping and continuing.
en.author: Loop
